svg.title: Laboratory technician — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as laboratory technician, wearing a protective coat and protective goggles. Visible work cue: An angled pipette releases one clear drop into the open mouth of a separate sample vial. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: protective goggles.
